text: An outdoor event may be canceled if there is heavy rain, strong winds, or extreme temperatures, but not if the weather is cloudy or moderately cold.
A restaurant is a local favorite if it serves traditional or fusion cuisine, while it has either a cozy atmosphere or a unique dining experience, but not both.
A person is considered a chef if they cook and prepare food, often in a restaurant, hotel, or other professional kitchen setting, using various ingredients, techniques, and equipment.
Not every scientist who is skilled in theoretical research is also skilled in experimental research, and not every scientist skilled in experimental research is skilled in theoretical research.
A celestial event is an eclipse if it involves the alignment of the sun, earth, and moon, and causes the shadow of one body to fall on another.
reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (CelestialEvent(x) ∧ Sun(y) ∧ Earth(z) ∧ Moon(x) ∧ Alignment(y, z, x) ∧ ShadowFallsOnAnotherBody(x) → Eclipse(x))

text: A pizza is ready to serve if it has a crispy crust and is topped with either cheese or vegetables, but not if it is undercooked.
A method is classified as a cooking technique if it involves the preparation of food, requires the application of heat, and transforms raw ingredients into edible dishes.
An object is considered a weapon if it is designed or used to inflict harm or damage to others, often for self-defense or during combat.
A sustainable city that invests in renewable energy sources and implements efficient waste management systems benefits the environment and improves the quality of life for its inhabitants.
In a school, a student who attends math class and has a passing grade in the class will be allowed to participate in the math club.
reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Student(x) ∧ School(y) ∧ MathClass(z) ∧ Attends(x, z) ∧ PassingGrade(x, z) → AllowedInMathClub(x, y))

text: A dish is a soup if it is a liquid food, usually made by boiling ingredients such as vegetables, meat, or fish in water or stock.
reference_fol: ∀x (Dish(x) ∧ LiquidFood(x) ∧ UsuallyMadeByBoiling(x, vegetables, meat, fish, water, stock) → Soup(x))

text: A city is an ideal destination for tourists if it has a rich history, friendly locals, and offers either outdoor activities or a vibrant cultural scene.
A vehicle that uses electricity as its primary power source, has zero emissions, and can be recharged through an external source is classified as an electric vehicle.
A sport played on a rectangular field with a net at each end, where the objective is to score by kicking a ball into the opponent's net, is soccer.
A university that offers a wide range of academic programs, has a diverse student population, and provides ample research opportunities often ranks highly in global rankings.

In an electric circuit, components like resistors, capacitors, and inductors are connected by conductive wires, influencing the flow of electric current by altering voltage, current, and impedance, respectively.
reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (ElectricCircuit(x) ∧ Components(y) ∧ ConductiveWires(z) → (ResistorsCapacitorsInductors(y) ∧ ConnectedBy(z) ∧ InfluenceFlowOfElectricCurrent(x, y, z) ∧ AlterVoltageCurrentImpedance(y)))

text: A vehicle capable of operating both on land and in water, propelled by wheels or tracks, and designed for amphibious transportation is an amphibious vehicle.
A building is a skyscraper if it has numerous floors, is significantly taller than its surrounding structures, and serves as a commercial or residential space.
A music festival that features a diverse lineup of artists, provides a safe and enjoyable environment, and is held at a convenient location can attract attendees from different regions.
reference_fol: ∀x∀y (MusicFestival(x) ∧ DiverseLineupOfArtists(x) ∧ SafeAndEnjoyableEnvironment(x) ∧ ConvenientLocation(y) ∧ HeldAt(x, y) → AttractsAttendeesFromDifferentRegions(x))

text: An event is a total solar eclipse when the moon fully covers the sun and the observer is in the path of the moon's shadow.
An animal x migrates to a location y if it travels from one region to another in search of better living conditions and resources in y.
reference_fol: ∀x ∀y (Animal(x) ∧ Location(y) ∧ TravelsBetweenRegions(x) ∧ BetterLivingConditionsAndResources(x, y) → MigratesTo(x, y))

text: An ecosystem remains stable when it maintains a balance among its various species, has sufficient resources to support its inhabitants, and experiences minimal disruptions from external factors.
A computer x can run operating system y with hardware component z if the component is compatible with the system and the system meets the minimum requirements.
reference_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Computer(x) ∧ OperatingSystem(y) ∧ HardwareComponent(z) ∧ Compatible(y, z) ∧ MinimumRequirementsMet(x, y) → CanRun(x, y, z))

text: An international conference invites speakers from various fields, like technology, business, and education, and offers presentations in multiple languages, such as English, French, and Spanish.
reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (InternationalConference(x) ∧ (TechnologyField(y) ∨ BusinessField(y) ∨ EducationField(y)) ∧ (EnglishLanguage(z) ∨ FrenchLanguage(z) ∨ SpanishLanguage(z)) → InvitesSpeakersAndOffersPresentations(x, y, z))

text: A piece of software that is designed to block unauthorized access to a computer network while allowing authorized communications to pass through is a firewall.
reference_fol: ∀x∀y∀z (Software(x) ∧ DesignedToBlock(x, y) ∧ UnauthorizedAccess(y) ∧ ComputerNetwork(y) ∧ AllowsThrough(x, z) ∧ AuthorizedCommunications(z) → Firewall(x))

text: An element is a noble gas if it belongs to Group 18 of the periodic table, has a full outer electron shell, and is generally unreactive.
An astronaut travels to and works in space, a pilot flies aircraft and navigates the skies, and a sailor navigates and operates vessels on the water.
reference_fol: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Astronaut(x) ∧ Pilot(y) ∧ Sailor(z) → (TravelsToSpace(x) ∧ WorksInSpace(x) ∧ FliesAircraft(y) ∧ NavigatesSkies(y) ∧ NavigatesWater(z) ∧ OperatesVessels(z)))

text: A celestial object is a star if it generates energy through nuclear fusion, emits visible light, and has a mass greater than a specific threshold.
